text:
Ana (growth): FYI spotted a weird bump in webinar landing impressions overnight for APAC launch post. can someone pull the hourly view?
Leo (analytics): pulling now. which dashboard?
Ana (growth): Launch > Webinar > Landing funnel, last 36h. link: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/webinar-launch?range=36h
Leo (analytics): got it. impressions spike ~15:10-15:40 PST (01:10-01:40 UTC) but uniques only +250. bounce rate also up.
Ravi (ads): we pushed a small paid UA test targeted at SG at 01:05 UTC. creative variant B (short loop) went to mobile feed. should be tagged utm_source=paid, utm_medium=cpc.
Marta: CRM shows new leads but channel = organic for many of them. suspect param strip.
MonitorBot: clickstream-ingest 2026-03-23T01:45Z finished. 18 flagged rows with missing utm_medium in partition 2026-03-23-01.
Leo (analytics): sampling clicks: 960 clicks in window, 942 have utm_medium, 18 missing. user-agent breakdown for missing: 14 Android webview, 3 iOS appwebview, 1 unknown.
Ana (growth): ok, same pattern as earlier webview stripping. we need to mark these leads in weekly KPI sheet so Friday numbers arent inflated for organic.
Ravi (ads): quick mitigation idea: append fallback medium on server-side redirect if absence detected. infra can push a small redirect rule today.
Marta: operational asks: 1) add dashboard annotation for the spike and link to ticket; 2) flag affected leads as "review" in KPI sheet; 3) pause nurture for flagged IDs to avoid duplicate outreach.
Leo (analytics): will add annotation and create a short note in the weekly doc: "03/23 01:10 UTC APAC impression skew: webview stripped utm_medium; reclassification pending."
Ana (growth): can you also surface pre/post CAC estimate for Friday? stakeholders will want to see impact.
Leo (analytics): yes. once we rejoin clicks->leads after infra patch, i'll compute pre/post conversion and CAC deltas and add to slide 4.
Ravi (ads): filing ticket MKT-5967: "apac-webview utm_medium loss" assigned to eng-redirects. also creating infra-redirect task INF-1257 for server-side append.
MonitorBot: rejoin job scheduled: join-reproc-2026-03-23-01 queued after INF-1257 deploy.
Marta: I'll hold nurture for the 18 affected lead IDs and add a CRM tag "hold-reclass".
Ana (growth): thanks. quick ask: can we also check whether the webinar reminder email cohort included any of these flagged IDs? don't want them to get duplicate messages.
Marta: checking... the reminder cohort cutoff was 02:00 UTC. 6 of the flagged IDs are in that cohort. I'll remove them and ensure no duplicates.
Leo (analytics): posterity note: will include a footnote in KPI deck: "Limited sample reclassification expected; final CAC adjusted after rejoin."
Ravi (ads): ETA for infra fix ~5 hrs. will update when redirect rule is live.
Ana (growth): wrap-up: Ravi 1: infra ticket + update; Leo 1: annotation + pre/post numbers for Friday; Marta 1: hold nurture + remove from reminder cohort. will brief execs in Friday sync. :white_check_mark:
